Pandora Raven — Album 8: Pandora Raven

When the Cradle Falls

"When the cradle falls, she does not let him fall with it."

[Intro — the battle in the final minute] They come through the gate All of them And the five hold For longer than five should hold anything And then they don’t

[Verse 1 — the companions fall, one by one] The formal one goes first She does not go quietly She goes with both hands on something and her eyes still open

The raven goes second She says something at the end No one will ever know what because no one left is listening

The wolf goes third No sound No word Just stops

And the priest

The priest is last

He does not close his eyes

He was already looking at her when the light went out the way he always was

[Pre-Chorus] She watches each of them She cannot stop any of them She is already bleeding from something she will not name

And then she looks for Olan

[Chorus] When the cradle falls She does not let him fall with it When the cradle falls She finds the last thread of the light and she pulls

Go she says Go where I cannot follow Go where this cannot reach you

When the cradle falls She sends him somewhere else When the cradle falls He is the only thing she saves

[Verse 2 — Leara’s wound, the corruption begins] And then Leara is there Right there Close enough to breathe the same air Close enough that magenta is not a color anymore it is just the distance between two women who should never have been on opposite sides of anything

And the blow lands

And something changes

Not in the wound In the light

The light that has always been hers clean and violet and certain turns

Just turns

Like water going wrong

And she can feel it leaving her wrong-shaped into the world into the air into everything that breathes

[Pre-Chorus 2] This is how it begins This is where the Corrupted are born Not from malice Not from choice From a wound in something that was never meant to break

[Chorus] When the cradle falls The light inside it does not die clean When the cradle falls It leaves something behind something unfinished something wrong

When the cradle falls She does not know what she has started When the cradle falls She only knows one thing left to do

[Bridge — the last breath, aimed at Leara] She gathers what is left

It is not much

It is almost nothing

But she shapes it into one last thing one last bright impossible thing and she aims it

At Leara

At the red

At the one who started all of this

And for one moment it is going to work it is going to land it is going to be enough

And then

Adina

[The moment — Adina steps forward] She did not have to No one told her to No order No command No logic in the world that says you step into the last light of a dying woman to save the one who came to destroy her

But she steps

And the light takes her

And Leara lives

[Final Chorus — the silence after] When the cradle falls Adina falls with it When the cradle falls She takes what was meant for someone else

When the cradle falls The south does not remember When the cradle falls The world does not remember

Only Olan somewhere far away somewhere safe somewhere she sent him

feels it

And does not know what he has lost

Or what was saved to carry it

[Outro — the field, after] The companions are gone The light is wrong now Leara is standing Adina is not And in the place where the light went wrong something begins that will not stop for three hundred thousand years

The cradle has fallen

One thread remains

[Coda] Rock-a-bye, Olan, sent from the cradle When the light breaks, the darkness will follow When the bough breaks, the cradle will fall And down come the Lighted, the cradle and all
